The friend’s argument misunderstands how the gas costs were covered. The user fulfilled their share via the company card (with reimbursement owed to the company), and the friend paid their own share. No further payment is owed to the friend. *(Note: If the trip was strictly business-related and the company card was appropriately used, the entire gas cost would be the company’s responsibility, and splitting between friends wouldn’t apply. However, the scenario implies a personal trip, so the reimbursement issue remains.)*
